posts.title: Organizing My Creativity — Project Folders
posts.description: Looking for a better way to organize your project folders. I found a solution that has helped me keep my project folders more organized and easier to find what I need to work on.

posts.title: Blackwing Pencils
posts.description: I got my first sample set of Blackwing pencils. I was skeptical at first, wondering why anyone would want to spend that much money on pencils, but I'm a believer and advocate now.

posts.title: Caitlin Clark’s Logo with Nike
posts.description: This logo speaks loudly about Caitlin Clark. It reaches out, representing a person of considerable stature beyond the basketball court. It’s elegant, clever, and represents a world of potential across several industries.
